widget.stats.title: Statistic cards
widget.stats.description: Each Mantis card rebuilt as its own component, layout and fill kept, ready to be lifted onto a real screen. The fills are the Ant ramp the theme already ships; the ink is chosen by measured contrast rather than copied from the original. Figures are illustrative.
widget.section.hero.note: Exactly one per page. This is the number the page exists to say, and everything below it is smaller on purpose.
widget.section.plain.note: A label and a number that does not move with time, or moves very slowly. The faint corner icon is decoration and is hidden from assistive technology.
widget.section.spark.note: For when the next question is certainly "is that going anywhere?". The sparkline is a shape, not the record: no axis, no tooltip, hidden from assistive technology.
widget.section.period.note: Any figure that would be different if you asked yesterday — on a PBX, most of them. The window is written beside the number rather than left to be guessed.
widget.section.status.note: The only card allowed colour, because it is the only one whose colour carries information. The surface is a light tint with an accent edge rather than Mantis's solid fill: white on warning measured 1.74:1 and on success 2.27:1 off the rendered page, far under 4.5:1. Every state ships an icon and a word too, because success #52c41a and warning #faad14 sit ΔE 0.3 apart under protanopia.
widget.hero.title: Calls today
widget.hero.caption: To 17:00, all extensions
widget.hero.compare: Up 12.4% on the same hour yesterday
widget.choice.title: Which card to use
widget.choice.question: Answers
widget.choice.hero.question: What is the most important number here?
widget.choice.hero.rule: Exactly one per page. Two heroes is no hero.
widget.choice.plain.question: How many are there?
widget.choice.plain.rule: No fill. A count with no state has no colour.
widget.choice.spark.question: Is it going up or down?
widget.choice.spark.rule: Only where there are enough points for the shape to mean something.
widget.choice.period.question: How many, over what window?
widget.choice.period.rule: The window must be on the card. A figure with no period cannot be checked.
widget.choice.status.question: Is there anything to act on?
widget.choice.status.rule: Always an icon and a word. Never colour alone.
widget.section.feature.note: Mantis's second row: a solid fill, a faint glyph at the left, title and a 56px value ranged right, and a darker footer strip. The strip is kept because the original has it — and it is also what rescues contrast: white on the blue fill is 4.10 flat and 5.69 on the band.
widget.section.channel.note: Mantis's third row: a solid fill, a count, a label, and a glyph in a rounded square. The original is Facebook/Twitter/LinkedIn/YouTube in brand colours; the layout and fills are kept, but the colour became a prop because a PBX has no social accounts.
widget.section.illustrated.note: Mantis's sixth row: the figure centred over a decorative field. The artwork is inline SVG rather than a file — docs/12 rule 6 forbids copying Mantis Pro assets, and an image request that has not answered on a card whose whole job is to be a coloured surface is not acceptable. Three motifs: waves, nodes, grid.
widget.section.mphone: Two shapes Mantis has no equivalent for
widget.section.mphone.note: A hero card for the single number a page exists to say, and a status card for anything to act on. These are the only two places in this set where colour is required to carry information.
